title: Workout (get_workout_by_id)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_workout_by_id(workout_id) — confirmed 2026-08-07 to be the same shape as upload_workout's response (see CLAUDE.md). Called by sync_pending_workouts only when it recovers an earlier timed-out upload from the library, to write the workout_detail measurement the upload response would have supplied. workoutSteps items are the ExecutableStepDTO/RepeatGroupDTO tree documented by workout_upload.schema.json, not re-enumerated here.

Verified against: 2026-10-17, a real single-segment running workout (all top-level and segment fields enumerated from it) plus a probe workout (deleted after). A deleted workout 404s. Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true).

author.description: Real account PII (name, profile image) — never stored.

createdDate.description: UTC, no offset, e.g. "2026-10-17T15:47:43.0"; the list is ordered newest-first by this.

description.description: For a create_workout upload, "Queued by Waypoint · ref <queue item id>" (sync._queue_ref) — what _find_prior_upload matches on (verified 2026-10-17 to round-trip unchanged). Null for workouts built elsewhere.
